control_plane.purpose: Durable control and resource-aware routing; dynamic work models remain unpinned

principles: Keep remote control responsive through a reserved foreground lane or background preemption.
Receipt and fast generation are separate from durable deep control and result presentation.
Local inference has no marginal monetary cost; use capable large models whenever quality or independent judgment benefits.
Treat compute, memory pressure, latency, and model switching as enforced scheduling facts; desktop and chatbot reserves outrank model size.
Keep only the small router/control model pinned; admit at most one unpinned work model.
Select the greatest verified parameter count satisfying explicit task capabilities and the fresh resource envelope.
Never retain or load a large model when doing so breaches the desktop and control reserve.
Prevent batching from starving older jobs.
Record every model selection, scheduling preference, and later substitution.
Choose the largest backend-supported context quantum inside the fresh physical envelope; OpenCode owns compaction within the retained session.
